Tensor operations generalize scalar, vector, and matrix computations to higher dimensions, essential for convolutional and recurrent architectures. Probabilistic inference via Bayes' rule allows dynamic belief revision based on evidence, while optimization frameworks such as gradient descent navigate high-dimensional parameter spaces toward minimizing empirical risk. These primitives collectively define the operational semantics of modern deep learning systems.
